class.name: GameplayAbility
class.brief_description: Base node for a script that performs an actor action.
class.description: Write a GDScript or Crimson Visual Script based on [GameplayAbility] and pass the script to [method AbilitySystemComponent.give_ability]. Each activation runs on a fresh instance under the component. The callbacks receive a [GameplayAbilityActivation] for that attempt. Implement [code]on_activated(activation)[/code] to perform the action. Call [method GameplayAbilityActivation.end] when the action finishes, including immediately for a one-step action. Optionally implement [code]on_can_activate(activation)[/code] and return a Boolean synchronously. The ability node is detached during this callback. Read the actor or its component through [code]activation[/code]. Returning false denies the attempt. Optionally implement [code]on_canceled(activation)[/code] for interruption of an active run. This callback runs before [code]on_ended(activation, true)[/code]. Optionally implement [code]on_ended(activation, canceled)[/code] to clean up a run. The callback runs once for an accepted activation. The flag is [code]false[/code] on normal completion and [code]true[/code] for cancellation, revocation, or actor teardown. The activation is already inactive when either terminal callback runs. Complete cleanup before returning from these callbacks.
